headline: Is Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies Stock Still a Buy After Its CEO Sold 2,300 Shares?
summary: Santana trimmed his direct holdings by 2%, retaining ~119,000 shares valued at $35.39 million. The sale follows a 57% one-year stock rally.

headline: Symbotic Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
summary: SYM's fiscal Q3 revenues rise 21.7% and beat estimates, while earnings miss as margins expand and adjusted EBITDA more than doubles.
